<description>
CI jobs download the same qa-assets inputs separately. As reported in #36814, these repeated requests can fail with HTTP 504 before the tests start.

Add one preparation job that checks out qa-assets once per workflow run and shares the unit-test data and fuzz corpus through Actions artifacts. Linux, macOS and Windows consumers verify the selected revision and file hashes before using them.

Containers mount the shared inputs read-only. Fuzz jobs use separate writable copies. Standalone CI scripts keep direct acquisition through the common download helper.
</description>
